tablet_felix: Consistently on kitchen_table_k1 in early morning (Day 28, 29). Check kitchen_table_k1 for AM; bed_b1 for late night.

mug_felix: Inconsistent. Day 28 evening was coffee_table_l1; Day 24 morning was kitchen_table_k1. Check coffee_table_l1 for evening; kitchen_table_k1 for morning.

charger_felix: Inconsistent. Day 28 late night was nightstand_b1; Day 27 evening was desk_b1. Check nightstand_b1 for late night; desk_b1 for earlier evening.

glass_felix: Unpredictable. Day 28 late night was nightstand_b1; Day 27 evening was cupboard_k1. Day 30 late night (22:19) was nightstand_b1, contradicting my guess of kitchen_table_k1. Check nightstand_b1 for late night; cupboard_k1 for earlier evening.

razor_felix: Erratic. Day 29, 28, 26, 25 mornings were bathroom_shelf_ba1. Day 30 morning (07:26) was bathroom_shelf_ba1, contradicting my guess of sink_ba_ba1. The shelf is the dominant morning spot. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1 first for mornings; sink_ba_ba1 is a rare outlier.

book_felix: Inconsistent. Day 27 evening was bed_b1. Check bed_b1 for late night; coffee_table_l1 for mid-day/afternoon.

water_bottle_felix: Inconsistent. Day 22 evening was kitchen_table_k1. Day 30 evening (20:36) was dish_rack_k1, contradicting my guess of kitchen_table_k1. It moves between kitchen spots. Check dish_rack_k1 and kitchen_table_k1 for evening; coffee_table_l1 for early morning.
